cards.title: One Director call pipeline: harness, CampNight and Parley share source resolution
shared_surfaces: @mage/director exports (night, CampNight, ParleyDirector signatures stay unchanged; consumers packages/tools/src/cache-replay.ts, soak.ts, w7-director.ts, camp-local-night.ts untouched)
acceptance: case 1: resolveCall with provider.id 'planner' -> source 'planner', guard.reserve and cache.put never called, planner draws returned in metadata
case 2: cache hit (forceLive false) for a non-planner provider -> source 'cache', provider.decide and guard.reserve never called, raw === cached value
case 3: cache miss and guard.reserve returns false -> source 'budget', error 'budget-denied', provider.decide never called
case 4: live success with cachePolicy 'raw' -> cache.put called once with the fresh raw; returned raw is the pinned cache record; uncachedRaw set only when pinned differs (harness parity)

case 5: live success whose output fails validation, cachePolicy 'validated' -> cache.put not called and a second call re-asks the provider; with cachePolicy 'raw' -> put called once (policy is an explicit, tested input)
case 6: signal aborted while decide is pending, then decide resolves -> source 'aborted', no cache.put, result ignored (CampNight 'ignores late cache writes' case keeps passing)

case 7: CampNight with the planner provider -> every completed group's items hash-equal to plan(t,state,id) per member (today's inline path) and its audit sources stay 'planner'; existing night()/W0 golden oracle and full-season planner replay in director.test.ts pass unchanged
case 8: CampNight.run issues requests from this.requests (built once) -> request() called once per group per night, not twice
premise: packages/director/src/harness.ts:55-84 - source resolution #1: cache.get, planner branch, guard.reserve, provider.decide, cache.put then re-get to pin
packages/director/src/camp-night.ts:60-93 - source resolution #2: same chain re-typed, with its own ordering (cache.get before the planner check) and no forceLive / uncachedRaw handling
packages/director/src/parley.ts:169-223 - source resolution #3: same chain again, plus abort/timeout racing
packages/director/src/harness.ts:74-76 and packages/director/src/camp-night.ts:88-91 - raw provider output is cached BEFORE validation
packages/director/src/parley.ts:211-217 - the opposite policy: 'Cache only after validation. Invalid replies never poison a future conversation.'
packages/director/src/camp-night.test.ts:125 - test is named 'reuses validated cache records' although CampNight caches unvalidated raw (camp-night.ts:89)

packages/director/src/camp-night.ts:64-69 - planner path rebuilds decisions inline instead of PlannerProvider.decide (packages/director/src/providers.ts:303-319), so CampNight planner nights record no planner draws while harness.ts:56-61 does
packages/director/src/camp-night.ts:36 builds request+key per group, and camp-night.ts:51-59 rebuilds both in run()
packages/director/src/save.ts:66-69 - save validation re-derives the same request identity; one call module gives it one definition of 'key'
cards.rollback: Two commits: (1) add call.ts + call.test.ts (no callers), (2) migrate harness, CampNight, ParleyDirector onto it. git revert of (2) restores the three inline copies; (1) is inert.
cards.runner_up: Derive save-schema.ts camp/session shapes from core types (tsc-checked schema builder) instead of a 46-line hand mirror that already hard-codes school const 'water' (save-schema.ts:26).
cards.body:
## Summary
The Director has one job done three times: decide where an answer comes from (planner, cache, budget denial, live provider, abort) and what gets cached. harness.ts, camp-night.ts and parley.ts each hand-roll that chain, and they already disagree on cache policy, ordering, planner draws and abort handling. Extract one `resolveCall` module with an explicit cachePolicy and source state, and make all three callers thin.

## Description
New `packages/director/src/call.ts` exports `resolveCall({ request, key, provider|transport, cache, guard, signal?, forceLive?, cachePolicy: 'raw'|'validated', validate? })` returning `{ source: 'planner'|'cache'|'budget'|'live'|'aborted', raw, error, elapsedMs, inputTokens, outputTokens, costUsd, metadata }`. harness.night keeps cachePolicy 'raw' (W1 experiments and tools/cache-replay stay byte-identical), CampNight keeps 'raw' by default so live outcomes do not move in this card, and Parley passes 'validated' with its validator as today. The cache-policy divergence becomes a named, tested argument instead of an accident of which file you read; flipping CampNight to 'validated' is a one-word follow-up for the owner. CampNight uses this.requests instead of rebuilding them, and its planner path goes through PlannerProvider so its draws are recorded like harness nights.

## Flow
- Write call.test.ts cases 1-6 against stub provider/cache/guard (fail: module missing).
- Implement call.ts; cases 1-6 pass.
- Port harness.night, then CampNight.run, then ParleyDirector.speak onto resolveCall; cases 7-8 plus every existing director/tools test stay green.
- Rename camp-night.test.ts:125 to say what it tests (cached records, raw policy).

## Expected impact
The next transport feature (retry, streaming, per-call telemetry, a second local model) lands in one place instead of three. The per-group source state that the camp UI needs (slot B) falls out of the same module. No simulation change: packages/core is untouched; replay goldens and VR vectors are not on this path.

## Evaluation
Claim: the three source-resolution copies collapse to one module with an explicit cache policy, with no outcome change.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (call.ts does not exist; case 8 fails because request() runs twice per group).
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - vitest call.test.ts + camp-night.test.ts + director.test.ts + parley.test.ts, then npm run gate (W0 golden oracle and planner-season replay prove offline outcomes unchanged).
Result: better
Gate: architecture

Invalid replies never poison a future conversation.` camp-night.ts:65-68 `raw = { group, decisions: members.map((id) => plan(this.tables, this.state, id)) }` (no draws arg). camp-night.ts:36 `groups(state).map(({ group, members }) => { const req = request(...); return { group, key: hash(req), request: req }; })` and camp-night.ts:51-59 `const req = request(...); const key = hash(req);` again.

cards.title: Night ledger: show which tents the Director has decided before the player meets dawn
shared_surfaces: SeasonView (packages/game/src/season-api.ts:2 derives it from SeasonService.view, so the new field flows without a hand edit)
acceptance: case 1: CampNight.progress() before any group finishes (provider pending) -> { total: groups(state).length, decided: 0, groups: every entry state 'deciding' }
case 2: after one group completes live and the next is pending -> that group 'live' with its rejected count, the rest 'deciding'; decided === 1
case 3: spent budget (cap 0) -> every group 'budget' (habit), decided === total, pending false
case 4: CampService.view() during the night slot -> view.night present with the job's progress; outside the night slot or after dawn settles -> view.night === null

case 5: nightStatus(view) with nightFinished true and 3 of 5 tents decided -> dawn button label 'Meet the morning', subtitle names '2 tents will follow habit', enabled true (player chooses), waiting hint present

case 6: nightStatus(view) with all tents decided and 0 fallbacks -> subtitle 'Read the Hollow Board' (today's copy) and no waiting hint; with offline planner mode -> no 'habit' warning (planner is the intended source)
case 7: refresh change detection: a poll whose only difference is view.night.decided -> isNightChanged(prev,next) true, so camp/listen screens redraw
premise: packages/director/src/camp-service.ts:81-112 - view() exposes only `settling` and parley state; nothing about the running night job
packages/director/src/camp-night.ts:18-26 - CampNight already holds `completed` per group and an `audit` row per group with source, error, rejected
packages/director/src/camp-service.ts:180-186 - the night job starts at dusk, so the Director works through the whole night slot while the player listens

packages/director/src/camp-service.ts:161-171 and packages/director/src/camp-night.ts:114-127 - pressing dawn blocks up to graceMs, then seals unfinished groups to planner fallback without telling the player
docs/design/reconciled/data/camp-play.json:186 - graceMs is 12000: up to a 12 s silent wait
packages/game/src/screens/chrome.ts:217-231 and packages/game/src/screens/listen.ts:112-124 - both dawn buttons are blind: fixed label 'Meet the morning', no progress or fallback information
packages/game/src/game-shell.ts:192-195 - poll redraw only fires on revision/settling/nightFinished changes, so progress would not repaint today
packages/director/src/camp-runtime.ts:11 - local and claude modes are real play modes where groups can be slow, denied or fail
cards.rollback: Two commits: (1) director: CampNight.progress() + view().night (additive field, unused); (2) game: night-status.ts and the two dawn buttons. Revert (2) to restore the old buttons; (1) is inert without it.
cards.runner_up: Parley outcome provenance: tell the player when their typed words fell back to the card (budget/timeout) or were refused, from the parleyAudit source the view already holds (camp-service.ts:102 exposes only usedCard).
cards.body:
## Summary
At night the Director decides every tent's next act in the background, and the code knows per tent whether it answered live, from cache, was budget-denied, failed, or is still thinking. The player sees none of it: 'Meet the morning' is the same button whether five tents are decided or none, and pressing it can freeze the screen for 12 s before silently handing undecided tents to habit. Surface the ledger and make dawn an informed choice.

## Description
CampNight gains `progress()` returning `{ total, decided, pending, groups: [{ group, state: 'deciding'|'live'|'cache'|'planner'|'budget'|'error', rejected }] }`, derived from `requests`, `completed` and `audit` (no new bookkeeping). CampService.view() adds `night: job && slot==='night' ? job.progress() : null`. On the game side a pure `night-status.ts` maps the view to the dawn button's label, subtitle and a waiting hint ('The camp is still deciding: 3 of 5 tents' / 'Dawn now: 2 tents will follow habit'), used by both chrome.ts and listen.ts. game-shell refresh treats a change in night.decided as a redraw trigger. Offline planner mode shows no warning, since habit is its intended source. No simulation change and no Director call change: this reads state that already exists.

## Flow
- Player finishes listening; dawn button reads 'Meet the morning' with 'The camp is still deciding: 3 of 5 tents'.
- The poll repaints as tents finish; at 5 of 5 the subtitle returns to 'Read the Hollow Board'.
- If the player presses dawn early they already know which tents will act on habit, instead of facing an unexplained 12 s freeze.

## Expected impact
Removes a blind wait from every night in local/claude play, and gives the operator a live view of Director health (budget denials, errors, rejections) in the camp itself instead of only in tools reports.

## Evaluation
Claim: the dawn decision exposes per-tent Director state that the server already holds.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (no progress(), no view.night, no night-status module).
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - vitest camp-night.test.ts (cases 1-4 with stub providers, as the existing suite does) + night-status.test.ts (cases 5-7), npm run gate and npm run build:game.
Result: better
Gate: direction
